description: Uitdagingen-curation (Landschap & Infrastructuur): CHS- en aardkundige-verstrakking plus een UNESCO-buffer.

scenarios.name: Cultuurhistorische hoofdstructuur treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-LS-04 (art. 7.9 op de CHS-umbrella, 847 km²) is a conditional marker; the strictest heritage reading excludes new landscape intervention there.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-LS-04 (art. 7.9) conditions intervention on the cultuurhistorische hoofdstructuur; this variant executes the strictest protective reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Aardkundige waarden treated as hard exclusion
scenarios.description: FR-LS-06 (art. 7.12, 99 km²) is a conditional marker; this variant protects aardkundige waarden by exclusion.

basis.provenanceNote: NC-LS-06 (art. 7.12) conditions intervention on aardkundige waarden; this variant executes the protective reading as a hard exclusion.

scenarios.name: Limes kernzone exclusion widened by a 100 m band
scenarios.description: Buffers the art.-7.3a Neder-Germaanse Limes kernzone exclusion (FR-LS-02) outward by 100 m — a UNESCO-buffer-margins variant.

basis.variedAspect: exclusion zone widened by an added 100 m buffer; the kernzone designation is cited (the separate bufferzone exists), the 100 m widening is the scenario's own parameter
basis.provenanceNote: NC-LS-02 (art. 7.3a) carries the kernzone exclusion; the added 100 m band is not cited and is the scenario's own parameter.
